MCDI stands for MicroClub Discord Interface [MCDI docs: What is MCDI].
PostgreSQL is the source of truth [MCDI docs: What is MCDI; MCDI docs: Architecture].

An MCDI API key looks like `pk_` followed by 8 hex characters, a dot, and 64 hex characters [MCDI docs: Quickstart; MCDI docs: Glossary]. An example of this format is `pk_66db96db.3aebaa1aac557ba0f597955dfc2e706a05b9dedc79ad26b8b3859417bfebe91d` [MCDI docs: API keys and server access].

Prefer using the `X-API-Key` header [MCDI docs: API keys and server access]. However, the guard also accepts the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and an `apiKey` query parameter, checking them in that specific order [MCDI docs: API keys and server access].
No, MCDI does not store the secret itself; it only stores a SHA-256 hash of the secret [MCDI docs: API keys and server access; MCDI docs: What is MCDI].

The rate limit for inbound webhook submissions is 120 per minute, which applies to each individual webhook as well as each project across its webhooks [MCDI docs: Local setup; MCDI docs: Inbound webhooks errors and limits].
A webhook returns a 410 status when an admin switches it off [MCDI docs: Inbound webhooks errors and limits; MCDI docs: Inbound webhooks overview].
The special permission `ADMINISTRATOR` from any source grants every permission [MCDI docs: Roles, permissions and inheritance; MCDI docs: Glossary].
The one-time code returned to a project is valid for 120 seconds by default [MCDI docs: Decisions; MCDI docs: Local setup; MCDI docs: Login with MicroClub (SSO)].
An admin session lasts for 24 hours and cannot be refreshed [MCDI docs: Decisions].
You need Node 22 or newer to run MCDI on your machine [MCDI docs: Local setup; MCDI docs: Architecture].
The `GET /api/auth/authorize` endpoint always goes through Discord, even when the browser holds a valid `mcdi_sso` cookie [MCDI docs: Login with MicroClub (SSO)].

MCDI (MicroClub Discord Interface) est le service central qui connecte les applications MicroClub à Discord [MCDI docs: What is MCDI]. Il sert de fournisseur d'identité pour les projets MicroClub, permettant aux membres de se connecter une seule fois avec Discord afin que chaque projet reçoive un jeton de session spécifique [MCDI docs: Login with MicroClub (SSO)].

Il offre également :
*   Un moyen unique pour signer les membres [MCDI docs: What is MCDI].
*   Un endroit centralisé pour identifier les membres et leurs permissions [MCDI docs: What is MCDI].
*   Un panneau d'administration pour gérer l'ensemble du système [MCDI docs: What is MCDI].
